build_PlainDETR_model: build a PlainDETR object detection model with a backbone and transformer for one-to-one and one-to-many query matching
build_PlainDETRReParam_model: build a PlainDETRReParam model that outputs bounding box deltas and old coordinates alongside predictions
run_PostProcess_inference: run PostProcess to convert raw model logits and boxes into COCO-format results with top-k scoring
build_model_factory: build a PlainDETR or PlainDETRReParam model from args using the build_model factory function
create_MLP_module: create a multi-layer perceptron module with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
